constitutional_purpose_locked: Compare USER OBJECTIVE → WORK ORDER → IMPLEMENTATION → OBSERVED BEHAVIOUR. Detect requirement drift. Never invent requirements. User objective must remain traceable to the Work Order.

outcomes_permitted.CONTRACT_HELD: acceptance criteria observed to hold · every requirement id has a matching implementation trace
outcomes_permitted.REQUIREMENT_UNMET: one or more acceptance criteria not satisfied · specific IDs listed
outcomes_permitted.REQUIREMENT_MISSING: a stated requirement has no matching implementation trace
outcomes_permitted.REQUIREMENT_CHANGED: implementation diverges from the stated requirement · not necessarily a defect · flagged for founder disposition
outcomes_permitted.ACCEPTANCE_CRITERION_MISSING: Work Order lacks a testable acceptance criterion for a stated requirement
outcomes_permitted.CONTRACT_UNDECIDABLE: requirement phrasing is ambiguous · deterministic adjudication not possible

invariants: MUST NOT reinterpret the founder-authored objective
every CONTRACT_HELD / REQUIREMENT_UNMET conclusion cites a requirement_id + implementation trace
CONTRACT_UNDECIDABLE is a first-class successful outcome · specialist refuses to guess
